meta.title: dsh-trae-skin
meta.description: Turns the whole GUI into trae.cn: near-black paper, a mint accent, a gradient wordmark band across the top, 2px corners and 0.5px inner-highlight shadows. The shell, the accent, the wordmark and the breathing light are all edited on this plugin's own card.

panel.noteReady: These values are written into the profile's config: they survive a new port and a restart. Nothing changes until Save is pressed, and Save checks every field first.
panel.noteUnavailable: This engine offers no settings transport: changes here apply to the current page only, and a new port returns to the values in the profile.
panel.noteStaleHost: The engine is still running this plugin's older host half (this page is already the new one). The host half loads once, when the engine process starts, so reloading the page cannot replace it — the engine itself has to be restarted (that interrupts a running conversation, and this page has to be reopened). After the restart these changes can be saved into the profile.
panel.stateSaved: The saved values are the ones the page is using
panel.stateClean: Edit a field and Save lights up
panel.stateLocked: This form is not writable right now
panel.stripOffNote: The band is off, so this has no effect right now.
panel.fieldSchemeHint: Dark by default: the reference is a dark-first product, so following the product would show a light-system user a design it never shipped.
panel.fieldAccentHint: The reference green is #32f08c: a fine fill, only 1.82:1 as a link on white — the text-safe step is derived separately.
panel.fieldWordmarkHint: The gradient line on the band, 1–24 characters, DEEPSEEK HARNESS by default; an over-long value is refused, not truncated.
panel.fieldStripHint: The fixed row at the top: the light, the gradient wordmark and the state in words for screen readers.
panel.fieldStripBareHint: No fill and no foot rule, only the wordmark and the light; the page still moves down by the band’s height.
panel.fieldPulseHint: Breathes only while the product reports reasoning; with no readable data-streaming signal it breathes continuously.
panel.fieldPulseColorHint: Follows the accent’s text-safe step by default, the one read against the page.
panel.fieldPulseScaleHint: 1.2–2.4, as a multiple of the light’s radius; 1.6 by default.
panel.fieldPulsePeriodMsHint: 800–4000 ms, 1600 by default; under reduced motion it fades over the same period.
panel.errorScheme: The shell is one of dark / light / follow the product.
panel.errorAccent: The accent must be written as #rgb or #rrggbb.
panel.errorWordmark: The wordmark must be 1–24 characters: not empty, not over-long.
panel.errorPulseColor: The glow colour is either follow or a #rgb / #rrggbb literal.
panel.errorPulseScale: The glow spread must be between 1.2 and 2.4.
panel.errorPulsePeriodMs: The breath period must be between 800 and 4000 milliseconds.
panel.errorPulseOpacity: The glow strength must be between 0.1 and 0.6.
